about: Which model does which kind of work when "Lead model" is on: the lead plans and hands each part to a helper by its kind. A tier is picked from the provider's own list (src/models/tiers.mjs); a tier the provider lacks falls to the next it has. The highest effort only for a part whose brief says why.

kinds.label: Running and recording
kinds.work: running tests and builds, searching the code, reading logs, collecting numbers, mechanical edits with no judgement in them

kinds.label: Writing and reviewing code
kinds.work: writing or changing code with its test, finishing a piece of work, reviewing a change

kinds.label: Hard thinking
kinds.work: a defect whose cause is not known, a design decision, the last check before the work is called done

highest.when: only for a part whose brief says why it needs the most thinking
